runtimePolicy: The development slice preloads both stage plates. Aggregate decoded assets and one reusable 200x180 RGBA fighter pixel surface total 13.42 MB. Each active canvas owns one 144 KB scratch surface, reused between both fighters; no per-frame canvas allocation. Display canvas backing buffers are additional viewport-dependent memory. Dispose image references and audio when leaving the game; per-match-only loading is a future optimization.
